children: Canada video infrastructure provider's fiscal Q1 revenue rose, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q1 declined yr/yr, with no analyst estimate for comparison
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for future quarters or the full year
INTERNATIONAL SALES - Revenue growth was driven by higher sales in international markets
OPERATING EXPENSES - Increased selling, administrative and R&D expenses contributed to lower net earnings
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the communications & networking peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Evertz Technologies Limited is C$18.00, about 21.2% above its September 11 closing price of C$14.85
The stock recently traded at 16 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 19 three months ago
